D/ CONSTANS PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVG Q NN

Nummus (copper alloy) of Constans. Reece period: Period 17 [330-348] Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two victories facing with wreaths. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVG Q NN
